responsibility: Provides the top-level entry point for Rust backend lowering of a crate and hosts several shared coercion and trait-object helper implementations used across the backend. It drives compilation of crate items through CompileItem and implements common conversions such as autoderef-based coercions, array-size checks, slice unsizing, dynamic object coercion support, and trait-item address computation needed by expression and statement lowering.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the main implementation unit for crate-wide compilation and shared lowering utilities. Unlike rust-compile.h, it not only drives iteration over crate items but also defines reusable HIRCompileBase helper logic such as coercion handling, unsizing, dynamic-object coercion, trait-item address resolution, and array-capacity checks.
